info.title: bbt
info.description: Bitbucket Cloud pull request CLI for developers and AI agents.

commands.name: api
commands.description:
Raw Bitbucket API access (accepts either `<PATH>
<METHOD>` or `<METHOD> <PATH>`)

options.name: --jq
options.description:
Run jq expression on JSON output (requires
--json and jq)

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Override workspace slug for this command

options.name: --repo
options.description: Override repository slug for this command

options.name: --input
options.description: JSON request body file for POST/PUT/PATCH

options.name: --paginate
options.description:
Follow paginated responses and emit merged
values array

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description:
Bitbucket API path or absolute URL. Supports {workspace}/{repo}
placeholders

arguments.name: METHOD
arguments.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS)

commands.name: login
commands.description:
Log in and store credentials (interactive by default).
Minimum token scopes: read:repository:bitbucket,
read:workspace:bitbucket, read:user:bitbucket,
read:pullrequest:bitbucket, write:pullrequest:bitbucket

options.name: --jq
options.description:
Run jq expression on JSON output (requires
--json and jq)

options.name: --no-retry
options.description:
Disable transient retry/backoff
as the profile default

options.name: --workspace
options.description:
Optional workspace slug to validate and store
as the profile default

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Profile name to store/update (defaults to
--workspace, BBT_WORKSPACE, or 'default')

options.name: --email
options.description:
Atlassian account email for API
authentication (prompted if omitted)

options.name: --token
options.description:
Bitbucket API token (prompted if omitted).
Minimum required scopes:
read:repository:bitbucket,
read:workspace:bitbucket,
read:user:bitbucket,
read:pullrequest:bitbucket,
write:pullrequest:bitbucket

options.description: Profile to log out (defaults to current profile)

commands.name: comments
commands.description:
List pull request comments (default: newest-first, one page
unless --paginate/--limit requires more; id inferred from
current branch if omitted)

options.name: --jq
options.description:
Run jq expression on JSON output (requires
--json and jq)

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Override workspace slug for this command

options.name: --repo
options.description: Override repository slug for this command

options.name: --limit
options.description:
Maximum number of comments to return
Default: -created_on

options.name: --page
options.description:
Bitbucket page number (1-based). If set
without --paginate, returns that page only

options.name: --pagelen
--paginate
options.description:
Follow paginated responses and return all
matching comments (bounded by --limit if set)

options.name: --contains
options.description:
Filter comments containing text
(server-side). Equivalent to
q=content.raw~"TEXT"

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: Pull request id (optional; inferred from current branch if omitted)
